batch.description: Jahangirnagar University D Unit (Biological Sciences), academic session 2023-2024, Set-K — full 80-question paper transcribed by direct visual reading of the Udvash 'জাবি প্রশ্নব্যাংক' (JU A & D Unit question bank, 2015-2025), book PDF pp.101-104 (questions on pp.101-104; printed answer table and printed worked solutions for selected questions on p.104). EXTRACTION STAGE: all questions are marked content-UNVERIFIED and all keyed answers answer-UNVERIFIED — the printed publisher answer keys are preserved as-is and are NOT official JU keys; cross-source verification is a later stage. Printed structure (the paper itself prints no subject headings): Bangla 3 (Q1-3), English 5 (Q4-8), IQ 4 (Q9-12), Biology 44 (Q13-56), Chemistry 24 (Q57-80). Botany and Zoology are both recorded as subject 'Biology' with the split kept in topic, following the standard 22+22 division of the D-unit Biology block: Botany Q13-34 (cell, microbiology, plant physiology, biotechnology) and Zoology Q35-56 (animal diversity, Hydra/grasshopper/rohu fish, human physiology, genetics). Anomalies preserved from the print: Q7 and Q8 are the same indirect-speech item printed twice in succession with minor typographic differences (both keyed a; only Q7 carries a printed worked solution); Q1 is keyed with two correct options (c, d), confirmed by its printed worked solution citing the Bangla Academy dictionary, and Q43 is likewise keyed (a, c) — both are multiple_choice; Q10-Q12 are figure questions (hexagon numbers, clock faces, face series) whose printed figures are described in the question texts/notes but not reproduced; Q68's options are printed carbanion Lewis structures and Q69's option (d) is a Lewis dot structure of chlorine (linearised, see question notes); Q79 is printed as a chemical equation only, with no verbal stem. The answer table contains no dash entries and no printed worked solution states that a question has no correct option, so no answerDisposition was applied anywhere in this pack. IMPORT COPY: verified subset (39/80) - see VERIFICATION report.

sourceDocuments.title: Udvash জাবি প্রশ্নব্যাংক (JU A & D Unit question bank, 2015–2025)
sourceDocuments.notes: Publisher question-bank book (Udvash Academic & Admission Care), scanned PDF, 295 pp. Set-K of JU D Unit 2023-2024 occupies book PDF pp.101-104 (printed book pp.100-103): questions pp.101-104, printed answer table ('উত্তরমালা ও ব্যাখ্যামূলক সমাধান') on p.104 followed by printed worked solutions for selected questions (01, 05, 06, 07, 09, 14, 16, 17, 18, 21, 30, 51, 52, 61, 67, 68, 70, 71, 73) — every worked-solution key agrees with the answer table. Book PDF p.105 begins a DIFFERENT paper (JU D Unit 2023-2024, Set-P) and was NOT transcribed into this pack. Transcription by direct visual reading of every page with zoomed re-reads of all pages and of the answer table; chemical/mathematical notation linearised (^ for superscripts, plain digits for subscripts).

papers.title: JU D Unit 2023-2024 — Set-K (Udvash question bank transcription)

examRules.sourceNote: Paper header (book PDF p.101) states: পূর্ণমান: ৮০ (full marks 80), ইউনিট: D, সেট: K, সময়: ৫৫ মিনিট (55 minutes); the printed instructions state 80 questions in the paper, all must be answered, 0.20 marks deducted per wrong answer, and no calculator may be used. These are transcribed from the book's paper header only and are NOT entered as a verified scoring rule.
